fusions.name: Arm's Length
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at its full reach of 3 tiles. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: White-Knuckle Drive
fusions.desc: Drives the blade in with both hands for 32 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Spade Down the Line
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Worn Handle
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
